purpose: Synthetic independent domain oracles for finance-head/QA review; not APK, Java, SQLite, OCR, UI, bank or device test results.

notation.monetaryTypes: All amounts, minor values, totals and formatted monetary values are JSON strings. No monetary value is a JSON number.
notation.numericTypes: JSON numbers are restricted to scale, counts and epoch-millisecond timestamps.
notation.inputs: Domain scenarios, not verbatim bridge payloads. Field names such as raw/detectedFields/variants describe evidence for a test adapter.
notation.expected: Policy assertions and independently computed arithmetic; decision/reason labels without a CONTRACT enum are descriptive fixture labels.
notation.operationState: An operation explicitly marked posted is confirmed. Draft/needs_review entries are not ledger records.
notation.currencyMetadata: JPY scale 0, KZT scale 2 and KWD scale 3 are explicit synthetic test catalog entries; the target runtime catalog must be checked separately.
notation.identity: UUIDs and token strings are synthetic placeholders, not real bank/customer data or a specification of HMAC serialization. Trusted identity requires CONTRACT namespace checks.
notation.sourcePosting: Positive/currency/date examples alone do not imply auto-post. All other high-confidence, source-selection and safe-identity preconditions in CONTRACT still apply.
notation.rawPreservation: rawSourceUnmodified/inputPreserved means retain the evidence/input during normalization or review. It does not authorize persisting raw source text or exposing it in Import/UI/logs.
notation.fallback: allowPostTimeDate is the parser boolean. Persisted settings only accept POST_TIME_IN_ZONE after explicit setup.

independentMethod.arithmetic: Hand reduction to integer minor units and Python decimal.Decimal at precision 100, without reading application implementation.
independentMethod.dateArithmetic: Gregorian calendar checks and exact UTC epoch-millisecond instants; UTC/Tokyo conversion is checked independently.
independentMethod.rounding: No monetary rounding, truncation, float conversion or limited-precision aggregate is permitted.
independentMethod.reviewBoundary: The finance lead reviews these fixtures; independent QA and court have not been completed by this file.

caseGroups.derivation: Locale is a suggestion only. Explicit KWD selection gives three-place zeros; no transaction or assumed KZT is created.
At scale 0, one major unit is one minor unit: 7 × 1 = 7. No decimal point is emitted.
Multiply exact decimals by 100: 1.20 → 120; 1.00 → 100; 0.01 → 1; 0.10 → 10. Missing places are right-padded, never rounded.
Multiply by 1000: 1.200 → 1200; 1.000 → 1000; 0.001 → 1. KWD is explicit in every input.
Stored/bridge MoneyDTO already has exactly scale places and ASCII dot syntax. Manual padding is not permission to accept malformed canonical DTOs.
A transaction amount must be strictly positive and lexically valid before decimal arithmetic. Empty, zero and signed zero do not become a saved zero.
Only integer part 0 or a nonzero ASCII digit followed by ASCII digits is valid. Equivalent numeric value does not cure invalid lexical form.
Count fractional characters before conversion. At scale 2, 1.200 has three characters and is rejected even though deleting its last zero would be exact.
Manual scale 3 explicitly interprets a single comma/dot as decimal, so 1,234 means 1.234 KWD. Manual scale 2 rejects the same three-place input; no thousands are inferred.
Valid source groups are 1..3 leading digits then groups of exactly three, using one space kind. 1234 × 100 + 50 = 123450; malformed/mixed groups are not repaired.
Generic punctuation may mean grouping or a decimal fraction. The KWD scale-3 example remains ambiguous despite fitting precision. Source precision is never repaired by trimming zeros.
An explicit KZT source stays KZT even with primary KWD. Missing/ambiguous/unknown currency is not guessed. Undefined scale -1 and injected scale 7 are outside the admitted 0..6 range.
For scale s, largest accepted individual amount is 10^24 − 10^(−s). Its minor value has 24+s nines; 10^24 has 25 integer digits and is rejected.
Independent integer sums are 1+2=3 and 10+20=30 minor units. Padding to two places gives 0.03 and 0.30 exactly.
Income minor = 900719925474099301 + 2 = 900719925474099303; subtract 900719925474099299 = 4. No binary floating point or bounded integer is used.
2 × 99999999999999999999999999 minor = 199999999999999999999999998 minor = 1999999999999999999999999.98. The 24-digit transaction-input guard does not truncate an aggregate.
The empty sum is the exact additive identity. Rendering keeps each currency's declared number of fractional places.
100 − 120 = −20 minor = −0.20 KZT. Aggregate net may be negative; neither a negative net nor zero becomes a valid positive transaction input.
October includes both October boundaries and excludes November 1: 100+200=300 minor. September 30 and November 1 remain in their own months.
Gregorian leap years are divisible by 4 except centuries not divisible by 400: 2024/2000 leap, 2026/1900 not. Valid saved years are 0001..9999; the next-month boundary is not a saved operation date.
A selected LocalDate is not an Instant. Changing the zone or inspecting a later capture timestamp cannot move 120 minor out of October.
postTime is 2026-11-01T00:30:00Z, but the explicit bank date is October 31. The 230 minor belong to October.
The instant is 2026-10-31T20:30:00Z. UTC retains October 31; Tokyo +09:00 yields November 1 at 05:30. Both require explicit fallback consent.
Without source date, consent, known zone and postTime must all be available. Parser allowPostTimeDate=false models absent consent; it is not a supported persisted Settings.datePolicy value.
OCR capture is not a purchase date. An ambiguous receipt date or an explicitly damaged bank date requires review; the missing-date fallback does not repair a known invalid date.
Only the confirmed posted 250 minor enter totals. A draft 350 and unresolved import 450 add zero until explicitly posted.
120+230=350 minor before and after assignment. Null is a real partition of expense; assigning a category moves 120 between partitions without creating a transaction.
Changing the partition and deleting its category preserve 120+230=350 minor and both IDs. Partition sums are not added to expense a second time.
Move the same 120 minor once: October 120−120=0; November 230+120=350. The later precision error preserves the complete last committed version, including November 1.
100 KZT minor, 2000 KWD minor and 3 JPY minor are different units. They have no common total here; a KZT scale-3 DTO cannot be silently rescaled.
The same event/revision is one observation, including after restart. A user-edited 250 minor remain 250; replay neither adds 120 nor overwrites the edit.
No confirmed ordinary income/expense is specified. The magnitude or minus sign alone does not determine kind; no refund/transfer financial treatment is invented.

Generic multi-amount notifications require review under CONTRACT. After explicit selection, only 12345 minor are expense; 999999 balance minor are excluded. The net flow −123.45 does not reconstruct a bank balance.
An explicit unambiguous final total is 12345 minor. Independently, 20000−7655=12345 and 10000+2345=12345 confirm it; neither derivation licenses inventing a missing total or adding lines to it.

A trusted token in the identical provider/account/reference namespace identifies the existing purchase. Linking evidence adds zero minor and preserves the stable ID; token equality is not inferred from amount/time.
Equal 1000-minor amounts one minute apart are only a possible match. The review candidate contributes zero; explicit linking still leaves exactly 1000 expense minor.
The same 1000-minor amount cannot establish one purchase. Once the user confirms two purchases, 1000+1000=2000 minor; both IDs remain, without automatic merging.
Distinct trusted reference tokens identify two purchases even with equal amounts and close timestamps. 1000+1000=2000 minor; amount/date equality is not a replay key.
Deleting the posted 120 minor removes them once. The preserved identity/tombstone prevents exact replay from adding those 120 back.

Remove the decimal point only after valid scale metadata: 9007199254740993.01 × 100 = 900719925474099301 minor. The display is derived from that string and never parsed as a replacement monetary source.
